transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. Thanks for coming in. What brings you here today?
I've been hearing voices and seeing things that other people can't see. It's been going on like this for nearly two years now.
Have you had periods where you felt extremely down, hopeless, or lost interest in things, or times where you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable?
I've lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy, and I just don't have the motivation to do anything. I don't ever feel unusually high, energized, or irritable, though.
How long have you been feeling this way with low interest and lack of motivation?
It's been about a year and eleven months since I started feeling this way. I just don't have the drive or care to do anything anymore.
During the times when you've felt down, have the voices and visions been present even when your mood was stable, or do they only occur during periods of depression?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed if the voices and visions are linked to my mood or how I'm feeling.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "psychotic symptoms during mood episodes",
  "question": "Can you recall if the voices and visions ever occurred when you were not feeling depressed, such as during times when your mood was relatively normal?"

I'm really not sure about that. I haven't paid close enough attention to tell if my mood was normal or depressed when I heard or saw those things. They just seem to happen, and I can't really separate them.
Have the voices and visions ever gone away completely, even for a short time, or have they been present continuously throughout the past two years?

They haven't really gone away; the voices and visions have been pretty constant since they started about a year and eleven months ago. But other changes and problems have been going on for a bit longer, about two years and three months in total.
Before you started feeling depressed about a year and eleven months ago, were you already hearing voices or seeing things during the earlier part of those two years and three months?
No, I wasn't hearing voices or seeing things during that earlier part of the time. Those experiences only started about a year and eleven months ago.
